messages.subject: class of dplyr df columns
parts:
I'm missing something here, I think.  The background is that I'd like to be able to select() only numeric columns and then operate on those using summarise().  There may be a better way, but in the meantime this seems make it difficult.  How should I think of this so that it makes sense?

apply(hflights_df[,2:3],2,class)
     Month DayofMonth 
 "integer"  "integer" 

apply(hflights_df[,c(1,7)],2,class)
         Year UniqueCarrier 
  "character"   "character"
